newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stocks steady, Keppel supported.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stocks steady, Keppel supported.

text.p: The Singapore stock market was seen steady on Friday in light, post-Labour Day holiday trade, dealers said.
They said share prices of shipping conglomerate Keppel Corp might get some boost from news it won control of ailing Philippines Monte de Piedad and Savings Bank on Thursday.
Selective buying of blue chips and good valued stocks which had fallen sharply recently was likely to continue.
The Straits Times Industrials Index closed at 2,004.26 on Wednesday.
